displayDescription: One bulb pictogram is carried card to card, growing links and then a ring of nodes: an idea becomes a connected system.
motionEngine: GSAP (local gsap.min.js, one paused seekable timeline at window.__timelines.video)
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
limitations: STYLE.json has no reviewed preview recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied, so the preview shows the style's core action: one shared pictogram is carried forward while the wider symbol changes.
Flat vector pictograms only. No material, lighting or depth simulation is part of this style.
The scene palette follows ILLUSTRATION.svg (deep blue sheet, light cards, navy symbols, coral accent for new parts), as allowed by the scene-dependent background policy.
No Blender or 3D tools were used, as instructed.
creative_pool.select_project_technologies failed with ENOENT because PROJECT_DEPENDENCIES.json is missing. Only native SVG and the supplied local gsap.min.js are used, with no npm dependencies.
